# crosswork_lock_users (Data Source)

This data source can read the Lock Users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_lock_users" "example" {
  id = "cwtest-lockuser"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `username` (String) Username of the user to lock
